We define coverage as number of analysed forms, and accuracy as the number of correctly analyzed forms, both as a fraction of n. We define precision as the number of correctly analysed forms as a fraction of the number of analysed forms. We measure the performance of the neural models in terms of precision (P), recall (R), and F1 on the morph level: For each morph tag in the gold target test set, we calculate P, R, and F1, and then calculate the macro-average P, R, and F1 across all tags in the test set
